findings.description: STK-SUP-010 requires the same fault to repeat several times in a row, and CON-SUP-110 specifies consecutive supervisor resets with the same fault code. SYS-SUP-028 allows an intervening different fault code; its rationale explicitly confirms that interpretation. CON-SUP-117 changes the latch point to the third detection but does not explicitly resolve whether an intervening different code breaks the sequence.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the treatment of an intervening different fault code against the product-owner decisions and state the resulting latch condition unambiguously.
